events.title: Demo Patch Notes V1.11
events.summary: Characters models sync properly (Probably)This has been an intense patch to get ready, so let's hope that it is as stable as we think it is.FixesImproved physics interpolation for when a player uses the unstuck button.The player no longer collides with the train horn.Improved collisions for all train cars.Player models now sync properly for everyone to make sure it is the same for everyone.Until next time, happy loading Yardmaster!Cassidy & Chunky

Check it out here:It would be a great help if you joined our community discord (https://discord.gg/9Bn4rpkMXV), so that we can learn better about what you do and don't like before we get to the full release!The full release is planned for the 27th of October, just after Next Fest!Happy Loading Yardmaster,Cassidy & Chunky
